name: plc-engineering-simulator-governance
description: Phase 1 governance and verification foundation for an offline educational PLC engineering simulator.

scripts.build:foundation: pnpm wasm:embed && pnpm --filter @govs/foundation-shell build && node tools/foundation/inline-shell.mjs
scripts.gate:closure: pnpm requirements:check && pnpm gate:foundation && pnpm verify:phase1 && pnpm verify:mutations
scripts.gate:foundation: pnpm check:toolchain && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build:foundation && pnpm verify:isolation && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.lint: pnpm wasm:embed && node tools/foundation/lint-source-policy.mjs && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.test:unit: pnpm wasm:embed && cargo test --workspace --locked && pnpm --filter @govs/foundation-contract test && pnpm --filter @govs/foundation-shell test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm wasm:embed && pnpm --filter @govs/foundation-contract typecheck && pnpm --filter @govs/foundation-shell typecheck
